name: Târnava Plateau
summary: The Târnava Plateau is one of the three subunits of the Transylvanian Tableland (DCT), it is located between the Mureș and Olt rivers, has a more rugged relief and higher altitudes to the east and lower to the west and south, it has two subunits: the Hârtibaciu Plateau in the SE and the Secaș Plateau in the N-W.
